android.desc:
Looking for a smart AI QR code scanner that goes beyond basic links? EagleQR (Eagle QR) is a fast, privacy-first AI scanner, QR reader, and barcode scanner built to help you scan smarter and safer — with security checks your phone's built-in camera simply can't do.

Scan with your live camera, use the flashlight, or import QR and barcode images from your gallery. Eagle QR can even isolate a single code when multiple codes appear together.

✨ AI SCANNER & SUMMARIES — UNDERSTAND BEFORE YOU CLICK

Don't open risky or time-wasting pages blindly. For safe websites, EagleQR's AI summary generator prepares concise, easy-to-read insights instantly.

• Domain Age Checker: Eagle QR automatically shows the age of every scanned domain, helping you spot brand-new lookalike domains used in phishing scams.
• Summaries save to local scan history — reopen anytime without using extra daily credits.
• Daily limits: 3 free AI summaries per day, up to 10 per day for Pro users.

🛡️ URL UNSHORTENER, LINK TRACER & PHISHING PROTECTION

EagleQR checks public website links with Google Web Risk before you open them.

• URL Unshortener & Link Tracer: Scan short URLs (bit.ly, tinyurl, etc.) and Eagle QR reveals the total number of redirects and the true final destination before you tap.
• Scam & Phishing Protection: Warns about dangerous links, malicious sites, HTTPS downgrades, and suspicious domains.
• Local-network links are never sent for online checks, and unknown app links never open silently.
• Open safe HTTPS pages inside EagleQR's guarded browser or a compatible installed app.

🧩 QR CODE GENERATOR & MAKER

Create custom QR codes on your device in seconds:
• Website links and plain text
• Wi-Fi networks (WPA3, WPA2, WPA, WEP, open, and hidden networks)
• Email addresses, phone numbers, and map locations

Preview, then copy, share, download, or save to your on-device QR tray.

📷 ALL FORMATS & SMART CONTENT SUPPORTED

Eagle QR decodes and classifies everything on-device:
• Matrix codes: QR Code, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417
• Product barcodes: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ISBN, GS1
• Industrial: Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, Codabar, ITF
• Smart content: Wi-Fi and Wi-Fi Easy Connect (DPP), vCard/MECARD contacts, email, SMS, phone, location, calendar
• Payments: UPI, EMVCo, EPC/SEPA, and supported crypto payments
• Security & identity: FIDO/passkey, TOTP, HOTP, authenticator transfers, WalletConnect, boarding passes, AAMVA driver licences, MRZ, he
